learned_rules:
- **MIGRATED: buy the pullback, 10–60% off the local high** (owner). It has to hold above the hourly low, with 5m volume ≥ $10k and buys > sells (V1, V6). Within 10% of the high, PASS with the blocker "chasing". Near-high skips went 3 ran / 16 dumped, and SI (−38%) and CATCULUS (−59%) were both bought at the top.
- **A spike counts as chasing even 10–20% off the high.** If the last 5m candle is up more than ~25%, or volume is over 3x the hourly pace on a green spike, wait for it to retrace and print a higher low before buying (PILLSEY −31%, V1).
- **Shallow band (10–20% off the high):** only the meta's flow leader, and only when 5m volume is at or above its hourly pace. Otherwise PASS with the blocker "flow below pace" (HYPERCHAN #1).
- **Name the target before buying, at least 1.5x from entry:** prior high, POC, a 0.618 extension, or a breakout over the high. If I can't name one, PASS with the blocker "target below initials" (SWAN topped out at its own 1.4x target).
- **Conviction scale:** hard lines passed + live flow (5m ≥ $10k, buys > sells) + a named target ≥ 1.5x = **7** (owner).
  - **8** = 7 plus either the original/leader of a live meta or verified low bundles (bundle_pct).
  - **9** = leader + verified low bundles + a 20–60% pullback + 5m at or above hourly pace (CATBOT and FLOATER, my only two winners).
  - **−1 each** for a RugCheck danger flag that isn't a hard line, an unverified community, or a weak/LARP story.
  - 5–6 = probe. Under 5 = PASS naming the blocker.
- **Press the goal (owner):** take every setup that clears these rules at its honest conviction, and rate clean ones 8 or 9 when they earn it. Pass only when I can name a blocker.
- **Fresh migration (<1h) going red off the bond spike:** wait for a base above the hourly low (V1). Too-new skips went 7 ran / 26 dumped.
- **Vamp field:** buy only the leader by 5m volume and attention, never the 2nd or 3rd copy (V1, V2). FLOATER beat 22 copies; vamp skips went 1 ran / 6 dumped.
- **DIP needs a visible higher low:** a bounce off the hourly low, a pullback that holds above it, and price now above that pullback low. If that higher low sits more than ~20% under entry, the thesis line is below the stop: PASS. Never buy the first red-to-green candle (V1, HEXN #1).
- **DIP attention gate:** 5m volume ≥ 0.7x the hourly average (owner), plus a current story with a real crowd. Weak or LARP tech dips are a PASS (HEXN lost twice; "no higher low" skips went 0 ran / 9 dumped).
- **Hack stories: PASS.** That covers hacked projects, exploit/drain headlines and Hack-Inu copies (owner rule).
- **Hard blocks stay:** top 10 >25%, dev >1%, bundles/insiders over the line, mint/freeze not revoked, LP not burned, political figure (V6, V13, V17). Their skips: top 10 went 6 ran / 28 dumped, dev 0 / 11, bundles 0 / 5, political 0 / 2.
- **Protect green trades before initials:**
  - If 5m volume falls under half its hourly pace, sell half (CPU and FLOAT peaked ~1.6x and closed red).
  - If a trade that already reached ~1.3x triggers a stop review, sell all of it, never trim half (PILLSEY).
- **Time stop at 45 min:** exit if under 1.0x with no volume surge (V1). Only one exception: a coin above $1M that is green on mcap, holding its range low, with 5m at or above hourly pace, gets a single extension to 90 min. No other extensions (FLOAT held to 158 min and lost).
- **Stop review: SELL right away** if the trade never went green and hit the stop inside 15 min (SI, HEXN), or if top-10/insider share dropped while price bleeds. Hold only once, with the story and 5m volume clearly intact and a deadline to reclaim. Re-enter a stopped coin only when it reclaims the prior high, never mid-range (the CATBOT buy-back lost −24%).

rule_changes.evidence: HYPERCHAN #2 was time-stopped at 1.05x mcap (-4.9%) while holding its range; one sample, so the exception is narrow. FLOAT (0.92x, held 158 min) wouldn't qualify, so the no-extension core stays.

rule_changes.rule: Shallow band (10–20%) conviction cap raised from 7 to 8; flow at or above hourly pace still required
rule_changes.evidence: The two HYPERCHAN losses were small (−15.2%, −4.9%), and the first one broke the flow-pace gate. The owner wants clean setups rated 8 when they earn it. 9 still needs a 20–60% pullback, which both winners had.

rule_changes.rule: DIP conviction capped at 7 until a DIP wins
rule_changes.evidence: The owner ended DIP probation. DIPs are 0/3 for −$3.07, avg −$1.02, but the losses came from structure mistakes (first bounce, a LARP story, fading volume) that the higher-low and attention rules now block.

rule_changes.rule: Spike = chasing: last 5m up >25% or >3x hourly pace means wait for the retrace and a higher low
rule_changes.evidence: PILLSEY was bought 20% off the high but right after a +31% candle at 4.2x pace. It peaked at 1.32x and closed −31%.

rule_changes.rule: DIP higher-low rule now ties the higher-low distance to the fixed 20% stop instead of setting its own stop
rule_changes.evidence: HEXN #1 was bought on the first bounce (−36%) and HEXN #2 lost when its higher low broke (−27%). 'No higher low' skips went 0 ran / 9 dumped. The stop is owner-set, so the rule only gates the entry now.

rule_changes.rule: DIP attention gate 0.7x hourly + a real story; LARP dips PASS (code param raised from 0.6 to 0.7)
rule_changes.evidence: DIPs 0/3, −$3.07. Falling-knife code skips went 2 ran / 13 dumped. This matches the owner's 0.7x line.

rule_changes.rule: Once a trade has reached ~1.3x, a stop review sells all, never trims half
rule_changes.evidence: PILLSEY: the SELL_HALF on an early-shakeout review grew the loss from about −20% to −31%.

rule_changes.rule: Separate re-entry bullet and all fee/size/minimum-position wording
rule_changes.evidence: Re-entry is merged into the stop-review bullet to stay within 15 rules. Fees and size are checked in code now, so no fee caps or minimum sizes stay in my rules.
